managedIdentityPlan.mongoCaveat: Builtin Cosmos DB Account Reader Role does NOT grant listConnectionStrings; it only grants readonlykeys. Need narrowly scoped custom role Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts/read plus Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts/listConnectionStrings/action at own Cosmos account, or parent-provided equivalent. Connection string stays runtime memory only; never ACA secret, AppConfig, source, image, log or file.
